headline: Last session: Sensex dropped 1,484 points as markets stay closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock markets BSE and NSE are closed today, November 24, for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the last session, heavy selling in banking and metal stocks dragged down benchmark indices.
Profit-taking emerged in financial shares following a four-week rally in Indian equities.
Weak global market cues added pressure despite sustained institutional buying.
whatHappening: In the last trading day, Sensex shed 1,484 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,400 level.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) extended their buying streak to 16 sessions with net purchases of ₹5,672.99 crore.
Investors' wealth grew by ₹34.61 trillion as Sensex recorded strong overall gains during November.
Trading on BSE and NSE will resume on Wednesday, 25 November.
summary: Indian share markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti and will reopen on Wednesday, November 25. On the last trading session, Sensex fell 1,484 points due to heavy profit-taking in banking and metal stocks. However, FII buying remained resilient with ₹5,672.99 crore infused into Indian equities.
